other_conditions: The applicant must be a legal nominee or dependent of the deceased worker.
The deceased worker must have been a resident of the Union Territory of Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
The deceased worker must have been engaged in any building or other construction work.
The deceased worker must have been registered under the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The deceased worker must have had an active membership with the Board.
benefits_summary: A financial assistance of ₹5,000 is provided to the nominee or dependent of a deceased registered worker for funeral expenses.
